integrity: The lower bound is reconstructed from the published affine tau formula and the crossing-change Lipschitz bound for tau. The matching upper bound is proved directly from the pure-braid factorization of a full twist. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The equality is restricted to braided L-space satellite operators, companions with epsilon equal to one, and pairs of integer framings in the range at least twice tau of the companion. It concerns ordinary Gordian distance only.
title: Exact Gordian distance along high-framing braided L-space satellite rays
